instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Tamsin will add a one-page (27) ........ at the front of her report, which will not count towards the word limit.
items.evidence: put a one-page timeline at the front as a figure
items.explanation: The tutor tells Tamsin to put a one-page timeline at the front of the report as a figure; it does not count towards the word limit.

yeniden_uretim.kaynak: sizinti yazim turu - dinleme L3 (kardes ajan gorevi)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: So that the order of events is still clear, Tamsin will add a one-page (27) ........ , which does not count towards the word limit.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: put a one-page timeline at the front as a figure
yeniden_uretim.neden_isaretlendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'olayların sırası yine açık olsun diye bir sayfalık (27) ekleyecek' çerçevesi olay sırası ve tek sayfa kayıtlarıyla tek doldurmayı bırakıyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cerceve 'So that the order of events is still clear, Tamsin will add a one-page (27) ........' idi: 'olaylarin sirasi' ile 'tek sayfa' bir arada tek bir doldurmayi ayakta birakiyordu. Karsitlik cerceveden sese tasindi - sesteki gerekce ('if you're worried about losing the story') artik cerceveden okunmuyor. Kalan cerceve 'raporun basina konacak, kelime sinirina sayilmayan bir sayfalik sey' oldugu icin bosluk summary / contents / plan / diagram / timeline arasinda aciliyor.

items.prompt: Marks are lost only when a student takes no notice of a (28) ........ restriction.
items.evidence: Nobody is penalised for a confidentiality restriction, but you are penalised for ignoring one.
items.explanation: Not being able to show unpublished work is not a reason for a penalty; the penalty is for ignoring a confidentiality restriction.

items.prompt: Each student now speaks for (29) ........ minutes and then takes questions for a further five.
items.evidence: Twelve minutes, and five for questions.
items.explanation: The presentation was fifteen minutes until last year; it was reduced to twelve minutes once the whole class started presenting.

items.prompt: The log book has to be handed in together with the report on (30) ........ .
items.evidence: The report and the log book go in together on the twentieth of November.
items.explanation: The original schedule said the thirteenth of November, but the adviser has it crossed out: the deadline is the twentieth of November.
